level1.text: For isotope imaging, a technetium-$99\text{m}$ preparation is made whose activity is $740\,\text{MBq}$. The half-life of technetium-$99\text{m}$ is $6.01\,\text{h}$. What is the activity of the preparation $18.0\,\text{h}$ later? Give the answer in megabecquerels.

An air sample containing radon is sealed in a tight vessel. The half-life of radon-222 is $3.82\,\text{d}$. What percentage of the radon nuclei is undecayed after $10.0\,\text{d}$? Assume that no new radon is formed in the vessel.
The half-life of caesium-137 is $30.1\,\text{a}$. What is its decay constant? Give the answer in the unit $\tfrac{1}{\text{a}}$.

A cobalt-60 radiation source contains $3.20 \cdot 10^{12}$ undecayed nuclei. The decay constant of cobalt-60 is $4.17 \cdot 10^{-9}\,\tfrac{1}{\text{s}}$. What is the activity of the source? Give the answer in kilobecquerels.
The activity of a sample decreases in $48.0\,\text{h}$ from $800\,\text{kBq}$ to $200\,\text{kBq}$. What is the half-life of the isotope of the sample? Give the answer in hours.

level2.text: The half-life of iodine-131 is $8.02\,\text{d}$. What is its decay constant in the unit $\tfrac{1}{\text{s}}$? Give the answer in the unit $10^{-6}\,\tfrac{1}{\text{s}}$.

The radiation source of an old smoke detector contains americium-241, and the activity of the source is $37\,\text{kBq}$. The half-life of americium-241 is $433\,\text{a}$. How many americium nuclei are there in the source? Use $1\,\text{a} = 365.25\,\text{d}$. Give the answer in the unit $10^{14}$.

A fluorine-18 preparation used in PET scans, with an activity of $2.00\,\text{GBq}$, is transported from the production plant to a hospital. The journey takes $2\,\text{h}\ 30\,\text{min}$. The half-life of fluorine-18 is $110\,\text{min}$. What is the activity of the preparation on arrival? Give the answer in megabecquerels.

An industrial radiation source initially contains $5.00\,\text{mg}$ of cobalt-60. The half-life of cobalt-60 is $5.27\,\text{a}$. How much cobalt-60 is there in the source after $15.0\,\text{a}$? Give the answer in milligrams.

level3.text:
In a living plant the fraction of carbon-14 in the carbon stays constant, because the plant continuously takes new carbon from the air. After the plant dies, the carbon-14 decays and no new carbon-14 replaces it.

The activity of carbon-14 per gram of carbon measured from an archaeological piece of wood is $38.0\,\%$ of the corresponding activity of living wood. The half-life of carbon-14 is $5700\,\text{a}$.

How long ago did the tree die? Give the answer in years.

A radiation meter near a radioactive sample shows $820$ pulses per minute at first and $10.0\,\text{min}$ later $230$ pulses per minute. When the sample is taken away, the meter shows the background radiation, $30$ pulses per minute. What is the half-life of the isotope of the sample? Give the answer in minutes.

In a fallout sample from a nuclear power plant accident, the activities of iodine-131 and caesium-137 are at first equal. The half-life of iodine-131 is $8.02\,\text{d}$ and that of caesium-137 $30.1\,\text{a}$. What percentage of the total activity of the sample is from the decays of iodine-131 after $30.0\,\text{d}$? Use $1\,\text{a} = 365.25\,\text{d}$ and assume that the decays of the daughter nuclei are not counted.
